An Open Letter to the Notion Community: Our Free Tier and Ecosystem Are Sacred.

We hear you. We’ve read the threads, the subreddits, and the tweets. You are worried that our acquisition by Microsoft means the end of the Notion you love—that we will gut the free tier, lock up the template ecosystem, or turn Notion into a bloated clone of legacy enterprise software.

Let us be entirely unequivocal: Notion’s unlimited free tier is here to stay. Our open template marketplace and the rights of our creators are legally and structurally protected. The Notion Ambassador network is not being corporate-ized; it is being funded. We are building the future of tools for thought, and we cannot do that without our community. We choose community over lock-in, every single time.

An Open Letter to the Notion Community: Our Free Tier and Ecosystem Are Sacred.

We hear you. We’ve read the threads, the subreddits, and the tweets. You are worried that our acquisition by Microsoft means the end of the Notion you love—that we will gut the free tier, lock up the template ecosystem, or turn Notion into a bloated clone of legacy enterprise software.

The Notion Ambassador network is not being corporate-ized; it is being funded. We are building the future of tools for thought, and we cannot do that without our community. We choose community over lock-in, every single time.

notion-corp: An Open Letter to the Notion Community: Our Free Tier and Ecosystem Are Sacred.

We hear you. We’ve read the threads, the subreddits, and the tweets. You are worried that our acquisition by Microsoft means the end of the Notion you love—that we will gut the free tier, lock up the template ecosystem, or turn Notion into a bloated clone of legacy enterprise software.

The Notion Ambassador network is not being corporate-ized; it is being funded. We are building the future of tools for thought, and we cannot do that without our community. We choose community over lock-in, every single time.

history: notion-corp: Today, we are thrilled to announce that Notion is joining Microsoft. Our mission has always been to make a single space for your thoughts, docs, and projects. By joining forces with Microsoft, we will accelerate this vision, integrating Notion's flexible workspace deeply with M365 and Copilot. To our community: our commitment to your templates, your workflows, and our design craft remains absolute. Read the full letter from Ivan Zhao.

notion-corp: To our community: We hear your concerns loud and clear. We want to make three commitments today: 1) Notion's free tier remains free and unlimited for personal use. 2) Your templates are safe, and the marketplace remains fully open. 3) The Notion Ambassador program will continue to be run by the same team, with increased funding. We are joining Microsoft to scale our vision, not to dilute what made you fall in love with Notion.

notion-corp: An Open Letter to the Notion Community: Our Free Tier and Ecosystem Are Sacred.

We hear you. We’ve read the threads, the subreddits, and the tweets. You are worried that our acquisition by Microsoft means the end of the Notion you love—that we will gut the free tier, lock up the template ecosystem, or turn Notion into a bloated clone of legacy enterprise software.

Let us be entirely unequivocal: Notion’s unlimited free tier is here to stay. Our open template marketplace and the rights of our creators are legally and structurally protected. The Notion Ambassador network is not being corporate-ized; it is being funded. We are building the future of tools for thought, and we cannot do that without our community. We choose community over lock-in, every single time.
